title: Floor Supervisor (Front-of-House)
description:
Summary
Lead the floor during assigned shifts. Deliver smooth service, control ticket times, support cash-up, and hand over to the Restaurant Manager.
Duties and Responsibilities
Pre-shift:
briefing, section plan, reservations/WAIT list, specials & 86 list, safety check.
Service control:
seat/turn tables, monitor ticket times, coordinate with kitchen/bar, handle complaints on the spot.
People:
assign tasks (waiters, runners, cashier), coach on the floor, manage breaks, do quick refreshers.
Cash & POS:
support cashier with void/refund controls, comps/discounts per policy, Z-report review.
Standards:
table resets, side work, cleaning roster, FOH stock (napkins, condiments, cutlery, glassware).
Hygiene & safety:
enforce handwashing, spill response, incident log; escalate hazards immediately.
Comms & handover:
accurate shift handover to RM (issues, VIPs, shortages, maintenance).
End of shift:
checklist sign-off, variance notes, lock-up support.
Authority:
stand down staff to correct grooming/hygiene; approve minor comps per limit; escalate bigger issues to RM.
Job Requirements
2–3 years FOH lead/supervisor experience in busy restaurants.
POS confident; can review Z-reports and handle simple variances.
Clear English/Tok Pisin; calm under pressure; fair and firm.
Basic Excel/Sheets; simple rota understanding.
Fit to be on feet and lift up to 15–20 kg safely.
Grooming & Hygiene (FOH):
clean pressed uniform (spare shirt), daily shower & deodorant, fresh breath, no strong scents, hair neat/tied back, short clean nails, minimal jewellery, closed non-slip shoes; no smoke/vape odour. May be stood down to correct.
Others
Hours & breaks (PNG law)
Roster:
nights/weekends/public holidays as needed; one peak per day typically covered by RM, the other by Floor Supervisor.
Compliance:
enforce food safety basics at the floor (cleaning schedule, sanitizer stations, allergen notes, spill controls).
Reporting:
reports to Restaurant Manager; supervises cashiers, waiters/waitresses, runners during shift.
Location/Contract:
[Insert site]; full-time; probation per company policy.
